verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Google Cloud publishing an llms.txt file or documentation formatted for agents to consume. The pack covers conventional human-oriented docs (gcloud CLI, APIs, IAM, billing), Vertex AI marketing about building agents, and MCP servers. Those MCP servers belong to a separate tool-serving axis, not agent-readable docs. The axis plainly applies to a cloud platform's documentation, so absence of evidence yields none.
